description: This Java class defines a custom matcher for testing purposes, specifically to match a string value within test cases. It extends the Hamcrest TypeSafeMatcher class to compare objects to a predefined string value.

classes.name: MacroCallParameterStringValueMatcher
classes.description: A custom Hamcrest matcher to verify that an object equals a specific string value.

methods.name: MacroCallParameterStringValueMatcher
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the matcher with a specific string value.

methods.name: matchesSafely
methods.description: Checks if the provided object matches the expected string value.

methods.name: describeMismatchSafely
methods.description: Describes why a given object does not match.
